scope: C1/C2 training and C3 development only; C4 never opened; no independent confirmation claim
estimand: Incremental predictive information from source-valid RPT scalar/voltage curves and measured Cycling operating signals, under identical V18 query rows, labels, weighting and fixed model settings.

cohort.query_examples: Frozen experiments/dart_rul_v18/data_protocol.py make_examples; all 3 arms share each source query; GO pins exact row counts.

replicate_roles.development: C3 replicate cohort with same G-group conditions but new cells

cohort.condition_unit: G-group denotes the operating condition/group; C1/C2/C3/C4 are replicate roles within G, not condition labels. Unseen-G group holdout inside C1/C2 training cells is a separate later analysis and is not part of this factorial GO.

outcome.event: First valid source RPT capacityAh <= 0.20 Ah at its recorded stop; this is a source-observed threshold crossing, not latent physical EOL.
outcome.event_binary: First threshold event is known by query when any arrived valid RPT is at/below threshold; event classifier target follows frozen V18 y_event.
outcome.positive_regression: log(target_rul_weeks) only where target_rul_weeks is finite and >0; unknown future endpoint rows remain event-negative only within observed window and are excluded from RUL regression metrics.
outcome.known_event_distribution: Use PointZero for already-observed event rows in evaluation, matching frozen pilot metrics.

features.F1: F0 + 612 RPT features: 4 C2/C5 charge/discharge capacity scalars and 200 Q(V)/dQdV(V) values; each feature contributes latest, difference from first actually arrived RPT, and past-only stop-time slope/week; every selected record must satisfy stop <= arm arrival <= query.
features.F2: F0 + 24 measured Cycling summary features as-of query end; cycle visibility assumes same-completion availability because transport arrival is unobserved.
features.F3: F0 + the F1 RPT increment + the F2 Cycling increment.
controls: control_capacity_normalized_shape_only (F0 + 600 Q(V)/dQdV(V) shape dimensions divided by matching leg/rate capacity; no four added capacity magnitudes)
control_rpt_full_vi_e_time (F0 + full RPT increment + 18 VI/E/time-only Cycling dimensions)
control_cycle_vi_e_time_only (F0 + 18 VI/E/time-only Cycling dimensions; excludes capacity/throughput/Q-end)
features.missingness: Preserve source missing values as NaN; use native HGB/CatBoost missing-value handling; no imputation, smoothing, clipping, future-schedule features, or test-derived scaling.
features.availability: RPT DataV2 valid record joins by original source_rpt_index and remains visible at protocol arrival after source stop. Cycling feature uses max(charge.stop, discharge.stop) <= query; actual data transport latency is unknown and is not represented as measured arrival.

unit_mapping.RPT_derived_dQdV: Ah/V (only for the RPT Q(V) source curves)
unit_mapping.RPT_feature_past_slope: per week of the source quantity after nominal-capacity normalization for F1/F3

features.unavailable_cycling_signals: No Cycling temperature, rest/relaxation, pulse/HPPC, impedance/EIS or dQ/dV feature is asserted or fabricated; dQ/dV is used only in the RPT-derived curve panel.
features.cycle_clock_quality: Combined24 features require both leg stop clocks to be valid real ISO. Unknown/malformed [] clock rows are retained in original derived assets, excluded from as-of model indexes, and counted only in audit metadata, never features. Naive source timestamps use the same UTC coordinate convention as frozen V18 (not a claim of measured timezone). Missing start time makes duration unavailable.

models.hgb: HistGradientBoostingClassifier/Regressor, max_iter=150, max_leaf_nodes=15, l2_regularization=1, random_state=42, early_stopping=False.
models.catboost: Classifier/Regressor, iterations=400, depth=5, learning_rate=0.04, l2_leaf_reg=3, random_seed=42, thread_count=4, no dev stopping/tuning.
models.weighting: Each physical cell has total fit/evaluation mass one; all arms and common queries share equal mass within cell using frozen V18 rows.
models.distribution: Hurdle event probability plus log-RUL regressor; 2-fold physical-cell-isolated OOF log residuals form weighted empirical positive distribution; full positive regressor and full event classifier per model/panel.
models.fit_count: Each model/panel uses 1 full event classifier + 2 OOF positive regressors + 1 full positive regressor = 4 fits. Ten panels x two model families x four fits = exactly 80 new CPU fits. F0 is retrained on this identical row cohort; no prior-model loads. All fits complete before any development predictions.

analyses.primary: Development-only paired per-cell and arm results for RUL MAE/median AE, event Brier, Brier4/Brier12, IS80, coverage80, severe_gt4w, and log scores; unknown targets are masked from RUL metrics.
analyses.factorial_interaction: Zero-fit cell-paired difference-in-differences (F3-F1)-(F2-F0), separately by architecture/arm/stratum, with physical-cell bootstrap 95% intervals.
analyses.no_new_rpt: Within cell/arm adjacent development queries with identical RPT history_key but increased observed cycle count, compare exact earlier predictive distribution shifted by elapsed weeks against time-only baseline and updated source-signal F2/F3 forecasts; report cell-equal MAE and event Brier deltas. No gain can refute a claimed RPT-gap update benefit but cannot establish causal mechanism because operating updates may be confounded.
analyses.scope: Development only; no independent confirmation, no claim of deployment performance, and no label-informed feature selection.

artifacts: Per-query feature NPZs, source-end row JSONL, separate train/development target JSONLs, complete per-source manifest SHA inventory, observed eligible query-cell/source coverage counts, fit artifacts/progress, row predictions, cell and arm summaries, calibration bins, paired panel deltas, factorial interaction and no-new-RPT panels, exact GO-bound receipt.
